name: Bowl para mascota Customizable/ Customizable Pet Bowl

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a simple, modern pet bowl shaped as a truncated cone with a wide, stable base and a narrower top rim. The exterior wall slopes upward and inward, leading to a smooth, flat interior bottom surface and uniform inner walls. The design is clean and minimalist, featuring a low profile with a wide opening that is ideal for food or water.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric pet bowl in OpenSCAD shaped like a truncated cone. The user should be able to adjust the outer base radius, upper rim radius, inner base radius, height, and resolution segments, as well as add custom embossed text along the curved outer surface.
captions.factory: The script constructs the pet bowl using three main parts: an outer cone, an inner cone, and a flat base. The outer cone is created by taking the difference between two concentric cylinders with tapered radii (r1 and r2). The inner cone is similarly generated using a difference of two smaller tapered cylinders to establish the wall thickness. A final flat cylinder is rendered at the bottom to form the solid base. Custom text is wrapped around the exterior using the writecylinder helper function from the external Write.scad library, rotated at 90-degree increments.
